values.title: On-site check-in exception
values.body: At check-in, one member reported feeling clearly unwell after arriving; they have been settled in the rest area and are awaiting guidance on how to proceed.

values.title: On-site language support request
values.body: Some members said they could not fully understand the safety instructions in Chinese and would like a readable version.

values.title: Departure roll call and confirmation of the number of diners
values.body: At the departure roll call, two people were confirmed to be temporarily absent, with 44 reservations corresponding to 42 actual attendees; the lunch supplier had prepared meals for 42 people, while the group accident insurance had previously been issued for 44 people and could not be reduced that day.
